known_limitations: Engine trajectories remain non-reproducible (libcg.so seeds std::mt19937 from std::random_device); schema v2 records this honestly (engine_rng_controlled=false) and never claims deterministic engine replay. Semantic replay reproduces the deterministic policy decision from the serialized observation, not the engine trajectory.
Runtime context coverage in the 30-game dataset is a subset of the 49 enum contexts (expected for sampled games); enum coverage is reported separately.

Terminal types draw/timeout/agent_error/environment_error are validated via synthetic fixtures (the engine produced only normal_win in the 30 games); classification is a pure function of final state. The 'aborted' enum value is defined but not emitted (not in the §7.10 required-coverage set).
